items.stem: Let A and B be two square matrices of order n × n and υ(·) denotes the nullity of the matrix inside the brackets. Then
options: max{υ(A), υ(B)} ≤ υ(AB) ≤ υ(A) + υ(B) − n
items.explanation: Official answer D. Response sheet Q86; you marked C — wrong.

items.stem: Let u and v be two n × 1 vectors with u′v ≠ 0. Let P = Iₙ − (1/u′v)·uv′ and Q = uv′. Then PQ is equal to:
options: The product of P and Q is not possible
items.explanation: PQ = uv′ − u(v′u)v′/(u′v) = uv′ − uv′ = 0, because v′u is the scalar u′v and cancels. Official answer A. Response sheet Q112; you marked A — correct.

items.stem: The interval of convergence of the power series Σ(n = 0 to ∞) |x − 5|ⁿ / ((n + 1)(n + 2)) is:
items.explanation: The ratio test gives convergence for |x − 5| < 1, i.e. 4 < x < 6; the (n+1)(n+2) denominator makes the endpoints converge too, but among the options only (4, 6) describes the interval. Official answer C. Response sheet Q92; you marked D — wrong.
